summary: The map-first app now works for the whole lower 48. M1 adds the zone-and-clock time API (lib/time.ts: TimeFmt, timeFmt, fmtAt, zoneLine, wallTimeToMs and the rest, with the deprecated names kept), state/timeZone.ts (fire zone, then place zone, then viewer; Public 12-hour, Command and Forensic 24-hour) and scripts/check-time-api.mjs. M2 is the national overview: the lower-48 frame and wording, three MapLibre sources (pinned, active, other) with size-aware clusters, zoom-aware labels, cluster clicks, hidden-fire data removal, legend entries, state on rows, card, hover and picker, the list 'N fires in this view · Show all M', the phone peek with relative times, sources[] notices and the §14.14 list-absence line. M3 moves every us-web file to the fire's own zone (0 deprecated uses, 0 America/Los_Angeles literals). M4 adds fire-card records through recordIssuerLabel and recordBlocks (disagreement blocks, complexes, id lines), the per-region accuracy label with every number taken from the regional file, and the V-R13 skill table. M5 adds national search ('Town, ST', ZIP + state, lat/lon order inside the lower-48 box) and coverage from /api/geo/lookup. All six cut-line items are done: (a) the accuracy line in the Analysis drawer, the Forensic Analysis tab and (f) the location card; (b) W11 windowing of the overview list and incident picker; (c) W15 phone fixes; (d) the rasters.test.ts carry-over; (e) UTM zones 10-19 and fixture-east reprojection tests. Late changes: tf is now passed at every us-official shim call site, the search examples are national, and the Alaska/Hawaii location card has its own nearest-fires line. All gates pass: tsc 0, lint 55 (all in src/scene), vitest 1,055 passed, build OK, backend 870 passed, checker 0/0.

contract_deviations: check-time-api.mjs also skips web/src/lib/time.test.ts (the tests of the deprecated names), not only lib/time.ts (§14.9.3).
fmtAt / fmtDayDate default to year 'never' (the caller asks for 'auto' or 'always'), so California Command strings stay identical.
state/timeZone.ts adds a usePlaceZone store: the overview location card sets the time zone of a point from /api/geo/lookup, and that zone becomes useZoneSource() 'place'.
zoneName('America/Phoenix') is Intl's longGeneric 'Mountain Standard Time', not 'Mountain Time' (Arizona keeps standard time all year).
Accuracy: the 'starts during main growth' clause is left out for seed regions (region.seed === true), so the real OSCC seed gives the exact §14.4 strings.
noPlaceMessage uses curly quotes (“q”), like the other search messages.
framing.ts CALIFORNIA_BOUNDS was removed and replaced by LOWER48_BOUNDS / LOWER48_START.
lib/plainLanguage forecastPeriod / burnProbabilityText / forecastDescription take an optional tf that defaults to getTimeFormat(), not a required one (us-official's feedModel imports them).
A small active fire (≤ 10 ac) is a 2.5 px dot.
Overview list: when the empty view or empty filter already shows the list-absence line, the footer is not rendered, so the line is said once.

Alaska, Hawaii and territories: the overview location card replaces the nearest-fires rows with 'Fire-3d lists fires in the lower 48 states only, so fires here are not listed. Follow local officials.' (new wording, not in §14.14). Places outside the US keep the list.
W15: on phones the frame button closes an open bottom sheet (updates, layers or analysis) before framing. While the chrome leaves less than 160 px of map, framing keeps the last usable padding.
